I am a 33-year-old in Quzhou, middle school finished. Ten years farming this same 5 mu with my father before he slowed down. Wheat-maize double crop, same as everyone in our village. My wife helps in busy season, I also drive for a logistics company in slack months so we have some cash coming in.

Five mu is not big. I cannot afford a bad harvest — that is one third of our grain income gone. So I do not cut corners on fertilizer. My neighbor Old Wang tried to save 50 yuan on urea two years ago and his maize came out thin. I remember that.

For wheat in October: I use Jimai 22, the improved variety the seed shop sells — everyone in our village plants it, yield is stable around 500 kg per mu. I apply compound fertilizer 50 kg per mu as base (that gives me about 15 kg N, 7-8 kg P, 7-8 kg K), then topdress urea 20 kg per mu at jointing in March. Total nitrogen around 24 kg per mu. I irrigate 3 times — before winter, at jointing, at grain filling. Well water is cheap enough. Spray 2 times — once for aphids and powdery mildew together, once for wheat midge if I see them. Plough once before sowing because wheat likes loose soil.

For maize in June after wheat: Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed, same as my neighbors. No time to plough between wheat harvest and maize sowing — I do no-tillage direct seed with the machine, it is faster and saves 50 yuan per mu. Compound fertilizer 40 kg at sowing plus urea 25 kg at big trumpet stage. Irrigate 2 times if rain is not enough in July-August. Spray 2 times for corn borer and armyworm. Target 550 kg per mu, that is what I got last year.
